resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list marks the site gone, while firelookout.com notes that the 1929 log cabin is still there. Both fit if 'gone' refers to the 1930s pole tower and the cabin still stands.

notes_for_editor: Tower fate conflicts and is not resolved: Idaho Fire Lookouts says removed (date unknown), the Forest Service list says in ruins, and firelookout.com and the FFLA list say gone. The 1929 cabin is described as standing by both Idaho Fire Lookouts and firelookout.com. The 30-foot height is left out of facts because no source says it is the height to the cab floor. No staff names in any source; only the 1950s emergency use is recorded. Drive-up is taken from the Idaho site's tag only. Two commercial camping listings date the cabin to the 1930s and say lookout guards used it; not used. Record elevation 1858.7 m matches the 6098 ft given by Idaho Fire Lookouts.
